🚨 Thomas Müller on the MLS: “There is no relegation. There is no big pressure. There is, 'Oh yeah, we do a rebuild'. Nobody is happy to lose, but it is totally different when you fight to avoid relegation”, says via Global News.

“Maybe you lose budget for the next year, the whole club. You lose people working at the club when the budget changes. It's totally different for fans. The pressure... the players may have no contracts for next year when you go down”.

“So, the playing style changes when you play a bottom-of-the-league team in Europe; they fight for their lives. And sometimes I have the feeling that, because of the system, the playing style is optimistic or more careless defensively [here]”.
